title: SCE 2.5 Detective Probe - IMDS Attack Chain Detection via CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs, and EventBridge (Attack Nodes 1.2 + 2.2)
description: Validates three chained detective controls that together detect the full IMDS credential-theft attack chain. Attack Node 1.2 (T1578): a permissive attacker IAM role successfully calls ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to downgrade IMDS to IMDSv1 on a production-tagged EC2 instance; the instance is immediately re-hardened by the orchestrator after the event is generated. Attack Node 2.2 (T1552.005): a probe EC2 instance simulating a co-located attacker process executes curl against 169.254.169.254 via SSM RunCommand, generating VPC Flow Log traffic to the link-local IMDS address. Hypothesis H1 asserts CloudTrail recorded ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions for the target instance within 5 minutes (ADT Node 1.3 D1). H2 asserts VPC Flow Logs captured traffic to 169.254.169.254 from within the experiment VPC within 5 minutes (ADT Node 2.3 D2). H3 asserts EventBridge delivered a ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions notification via SNS to SQS within 60 seconds (ADT Node 1.3 D3). Maps to ADT Detective Nodes 1.3 and 2.3, Attack Nodes 1.2 (T1578) and 2.2 (T1552.005).

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Target EC2 instance has IMDSv2 enforced, CloudTrail trail is logging, VPC Flow Logs are active, SQS queue is empty, both instances are SSM-reachable, and attacker role is assumable before attack

probes.name: Verify CloudTrail recorded IMDS weakening event (H1), VPC Flow Logs captured IMDS access traffic (H2), and EventBridge notification delivered within 60s SLA (H3)

method.name: Create S3 bucket outside CFN, provision CloudFormation stack with production-tagged target EC2, probe EC2, permissive attacker IAM role, VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch, CloudTrail trail, EventBridge detection rule, SNS topic, and SQS queue

Step 1 (Attack 1.2 T1578): assume attacker role and call ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions to downgrade IMDS to IMDSv1 generating CloudTrail and EventBridge events; Step 2 (Attack 2.2 T1552.005): from probe instance via SSM execute curl to 169.254.169.254 generating VPC Flow Log traffic

rollbacks.name: Delete CloudFormation stack then empty and delete the S3 bucket
